description: Mission 1 gameplay sounds of the N64 port. Each entry is an original 68000 sound request word (ROM 0120F8) with the callers that issued it in MAME gameplay captures (tools/extract_sound_map.py) and the latch bytes that render it in isolation (tools/render_sound_commands.py). Numbers only; the audio is rendered locally from the user's ROM.

sounds.label: explosion
sounds.event: thrown object burst on terrain contact (ROM 03BE52) / grenade explosion (ROM 01C152)

sounds.label: rebel_103e
sounds.event: animation sound command 0x30 (ROM 004486) in rebel programs 240588/2406EC/240A3E/240AE6/240DEE/24103C

sounds.label: rebel_103f
sounds.event: animation sound command 0x30 in rebel programs 240588/2406EC/240C6E/240C76/240D2E/240D3C/241056; not observed in a capture

sounds.label: rebel_1040
sounds.event: animation sound command 0x30 in rebel programs 240E8E/2410E2; not observed in a capture

sounds.label: rebel_1041
sounds.event: animation sound command 0x30 in rebel programs 240588/2406EC/240DEE/240F8E

sounds.label: rebel_1042
sounds.event: animation sound command 0x30 in rebel program 240DEE

sounds.label: rebel_1043
sounds.event: animation sound command 0x30 in rebel program 2404FE

sounds.label: vehicle_hit
sounds.event: player bullet hits the armoured vehicle (health -10)

sounds.label: vehicle_smoke
sounds.event: vehicle health below half and vehicle destroyed (ROM 029AE4)

sounds.label: vehicle_engine_stop
sounds.event: vehicle destroyed, health 0 (ROM 0294A2 via 012192: 0x0C then 0x10A5). Rendered silent: 0x10A5 alone is a continuous (looping) sound started when the vehicle appears (ROM 029220) and 0x0C+0x10A5 stops it. Not packed: the native vehicle has no appearance event and the engine loop point was not measured.

sounds.label: vehicle_burst
sounds.event: vehicle destruction burst, 12 video frames after health 0 (ROM 029B14)

sounds.label: music_mission1
sounds.event: Mission 1 music, after the driver reset 03 and 06 at the mission start
